objective: Eliminate all R/S and E/Z errors across the complete 209-system ct209 dataset while reducing bond-length and bond-angle error through direct weight-space programming.
criterion_history: The user initially required zero R/S and E/Z errors across all 209 systems.
The user additionally required improvement in R/S, E/Z, bond length, and bond angle.
The user explicitly confirmed that the zero R/S and E/Z error requirement remains mandatory.

primary_acceptance.median_bond_length_rms_error: strictly lower than the paired base checkpoint
primary_acceptance.median_bond_angle_rms_error: strictly lower than the paired base checkpoint

evaluation_extension: Use modern CIP R/S agreement and full_ez_all including readable defined ring E/Z bonds. Preserve the original RGI-scoped ez_all metric separately. Report heavy-atom-undecidable bonds explicitly and require one common graph mapping for full_stereo_all.
development_policy: Continue mechanistic diagnosis on the development split. Previous validation results are now known; preserve their history and do not call repeated validation independent. Keep the 104-system test split unused until a candidate meets zero R/S and E/Z errors and improves bond-length and bond-angle error in development and validation.
test_policy: Freeze checkpoint and criteria before the first test evaluation. If test results inform any later edit, explicitly mark the test split as used for development; a future 209/209 result then demonstrates dataset performance, not independent generalization.
completion_policy: The goal remains incomplete unless all acceptance criteria are directly verified on all 209 systems without exclusions. Report paired confidence intervals, per-system regressions, and all failures. Single-seed success does not establish seed robustness or performance beyond ct209.
